program: Wingless pre-outcome conditional low-support fallback counterfactual
question: Can a frozen native-state condition preserve the three useful low-support fallback hits while avoiding fallback on a bounded subset plausibly associated with the class-5/6 suppression signal, without using future target bytes or labels?
hypothesis: Replay exact R8/R7 data, budgets, 256 motifs, 8x32 classes, relation tables, code target, and depth-3 cap. BASELINE remains B11 full repair. CANDIDATE uses only the already-observed current pair before rollout: if pair support<3 AND the current motif (curr) belongs to training-defined reasoning class 5 or 6, disable low-support fallback for the entire depth-3 rollout while retaining exact-context logic; otherwise use byte-identical B11. The condition cannot inspect later motifs in the query window, the truth motif, heldout labels, target outcomes, or post-result statistics. This is an originating-dataset mechanism probe only and cannot be retained from R9. Any useful candidate must later pass a disjoint future-data transfer test under identical budgets.

portfolio_context.role: advisory-only; candidate must improve task learning/transfer, not merely internal state

prior_evidence.interpretation: All harm from globally disabling fallback occurs on nonselected queries with initial pair support<3; future-window selected membership cannot itself be used as a legal inference-time condition.

external_authority.execution_host_policy: GitHub-hosted compute only; host distinct from LINKDEADKB

frozen_reuse.baseline: B11 full repaired bridge byte-identical R8
frozen_reuse.conditional_candidate: if initial pair support<3 and class(curr) in {5,6}, use B01 for entire rollout; else B11
allowed_condition_inputs: training-defined class of current observed motif

evaluation.safety_metric: candidate exact hits must not fall below baseline
evaluation.selected_diagnostic_metric: candidate selected-query exact hits - baseline selected-query exact hits

classification_rules.supported: Validity passes; candidate improves total exact hits by at least one without reducing selected-query exact hits or violating controls.
classification_rules.mixed: Validity passes; candidate preserves total and selected-query exact hits while changing at least one query's bridge mode or prediction, but does not improve total exact hits.
classification_rules.negative: Validity passes but candidate reduces total or selected-query exact hits, or makes no prediction-relevant difference.
classification_rules.invalid: Any parent, authority, source, budget, representation, condition identity/input boundary, bridge identity, target identity, determinism, provenance, capacity, or qualification criterion fails.

successor_if_supported.intent: test exact frozen conditional candidate against no-change on a preregistered disjoint future dataset under identical data/compute/capacity/authority budgets; retain only on transfer

successor_if_mixed_or_negative.intent: stop optimizing this originating-dataset bridge mechanism and return to native training signals that predict future-dataset learning efficiency under fixed budgets

no_post_result_tuning_rule: Do not alter data, budgets, 256 capacity, classes, pair-support threshold 3, current-class set {5,6}, baseline/candidate bridge variants, metrics, thresholds, classification, or authority after primary output.
